categories.name: Veneers
categories.blurb: Our specialty. Over 10,000 veneer cases, from no-drill shells to full porcelain smiles.

categories.name: Whitening & makeovers
categories.blurb: Brighter, more even smiles without changing what makes yours yours.

categories.name: Everyday dentistry
categories.blurb: Conservative care that keeps the rest of your mouth healthy.

services.name: No-prep veneers
services.description: Thin veneers bonded onto your teeth with no drilling and no tooth reduction. Minimally invasive, natural looking, and your tooth structure stays intact.

services.name: Direct composite veneers
services.description: Tooth-coloured composite shaped by hand right on your teeth in the chair. Closes gaps, fixes chips and evens out shape, often in a single visit.

services.name: Porcelain veneers
services.description: Custom ceramic shells made from a model of your teeth, for a durable, stain-resistant smile with a natural glassy finish.

services.name: Laser teeth whitening
services.description: In-clinic whitening with a protective gum barrier and a light-activated gel. Visibly whiter teeth in one session.

services.name: Smile makeover
services.description: A full plan that combines veneers, whitening and reshaping so your whole smile fits your face, not just one tooth.

services.name: Consultation & check-up
services.description: A careful look at your teeth and gums, an honest talk about options, and a plan you understand before anything starts.

services.name: Cleaning
services.description: Scaling and polishing to remove plaque and tartar, and the best way to keep veneers and natural teeth looking good.

services.name: Fillings
services.description: Tooth-coloured fillings that repair decay while saving as much healthy tooth as possible.

services.name: Tooth extraction
services.description: Gentle removal of teeth that can't be saved, including wisdom teeth, with clear aftercare.

services.name: Braces
services.description: Orthodontic treatment to straighten teeth and correct your bite, on its own or before veneers.
